caption: The drawing depicts a single object centrally placed on the page, rendered in shades of gray and black on a beige background. The object is composed of several distinct parts: a prominent circular glass or lens element at the top, which is encased within a thick, round frame that has a small cap or hood partially covering the upper portion of the circle. Directly below the circular element is a horizontally oriented cylindrical body supported by a short, downward extension. The stem beneath the main body is ornately turned, transitioning smoothly into a wide, round base that provides stability. To the lower right corner of the main rectangular border, there is a small inset sketch that replicates the main object but in simplified outline form, providing a scaled and less detailed side view. The overall composition is symmetrical, and the use of shading emphasizes the rounded surfaces and metallic or glassy texture of the object.
